Case Study · Premium Hotel · Quito

From invisible hotel
to premium destination

The hotel only had room and building photos on their website — generic images that said nothing about why they were different. We completely transformed their visual identity: shifting from documenting spaces to telling the story of who's behind it, what makes them different, and why choosing them is safe and special in a city where security is a real concern for travelers.

Security
you can see

In a city with high insecurity, we put into images what was previously only a verbal promise. The security staff — elegant, professional, human — communicates trust before the guest even books. We're not selling surveillance: we're selling peace of mind.

The people
who make it possible

We put a face and name to everyone behind the scenes: the chef, the receptionist, the manager, the service team. People trust people. When a guest sees a real, passionate team, the booking decision becomes emotional — and price stops being the first consideration.

Atmosphere
that invites you to stay

Instead of empty rooms, we captured the experience: morning light on the pool, the live kitchen, the inviting spaces. Every image solves the ideal guest's problem — "will I feel good here?" — before they even ask it.

Video & Short-Form Content

Content that
converts

I produce short-form video content with the same editorial eye as my photography. Not just capture — strategic visual narrative that generates emotion first and conversion second. Proven results: 25+ mini-sessions sold from a single Reel.

Top of Funnel · Demand Creation

"When was the last time you held your child?"

Technique: Loss Aversion + Anticipatory Nostalgia. No direct selling — activates the emotional fear of not having documented a moment that already passed. Creates the need before presenting the service. Purpose: generate latent demand and deep emotional connection.

Bottom of Funnel · Direct Conversion

Mother's Day Mini Sessions

Result: 25+ sessions sold from a single organic Reel. Technique: time-urgency offer + social proof + direct CTA. The demand creation video (above) seeded the emotion; this one converts that emotion into action. Full-funnel strategy executed in 2 pieces.

Brand Awareness · Cinematic Storytelling

Editorial Wedding Film — One Minute, One Story

Technique: Cinematic Brand Showcase. No voiceover, no text — pure visual storytelling. Every cut is intentional, every frame chosen for emotional weight. Shows what editorial direction looks like in practice: not a slide show of photos, but a short film. Purpose: demonstrate craft, build desire, position the brand at a premium level.

Digital Campaign Result

Full funnel executed: emotional awareness → desire → direct conversion. 25+ sales in April-May season.
